source_identity.title: Record High
source_identity.body_text:
Outlook 10/07: Stock futures print record highs on Tuesday, boosted by gains in key technology names as well as declines in Treasury yields and oil prices. The benchmark 10-year Treasury note yield fell 5 basis points to 5.256%. The 30-year bond yield slipped more than 3 basis points to trade at 5.625%. Alongside Treasury yields, a drop in oil prices also gave equities a boost Tuesday. Brent crude traded 2% lower at around $98 per barrel. WTI futures shed 2% to roughly $87 a barrel. Traders are now looking ahead to the FOMC minutes from last meeting due Wednesday, which could shed some light on policymakers move to raise rates.
ESZ26 (Dec2026): YVAH 7848 YPOC 7830 YVAL 7800 GAP 7830 IVR 89
/ES Plan: Yesterday market closed bullish (PBT 7902), and overnight continues on that way, moving above value/range, so these're the opening and initial balance options for current session:
A) If market remains above YHOD 7848 with bullish VIX/CVD, buy towards ATH-ON 7868 and PBTs 7878-7890-7902-7915 magnets.
B) If market moves below YHOD 7848 with bearish VIX/CVD, sell towards YPOC-GAP 7830 and YVAL 7800 magnets.
Note: Overnight inventory is 100% bullish. The expected action is a counter-auction. Failure to see the counter-auction would be an indication of potential bullish trend day. If market opens above value and it begins to trade within value, VAR bearish setup comes in play. Remember that a new record high has been printed overnight, so it's still pending to be revisited at regular hours.

10:45 Fed's Bowman Speaks
13:00 3-Year Note Auction
13:15 Fed's Schmid Speaks

source_identity.title: FOMC minutes
source_identity.body_text:
Outlook 10/07: Stock futures fall on Wednesday, as oil prices moved higher alongside Treasury yields. U.S. crude prices crept back toward $90 per barrel. Yields, which took a breather yesterday, resume the recent surge that drove them to multiyear highs. The benchmark 10-year Treasury note yield climbed more than 6 basis points to trade at 5.337%. Investors are awaiting the minutes of the Federal Reserve’s last meeting in September, at which the U.S. central bank raised interest rates for the first time since 2023. Minutes are set to shed light on how monetary policymakers are thinking about economic conditions.

source_identity.title: Record High
source_identity.body_text:
Outlook 10/07: Stock futures print record highs on Tuesday, boosted by gains in key technology names as well as declines in Treasury yields and oil prices. The benchmark 10-year Treasury note yield fell 5 basis points to 5.256%. The 30-year bond yield slipped more than 3 basis points to trade at 5.625%. Alongside Treasury yields, a drop in oil prices also gave equities a boost Tuesday. Brent crude traded 2% lower at around $98 per barrel. WTI futures shed 2% to roughly $87 a barrel. Traders are now looking ahead to the FOMC minutes from last meeting due Wednesday, which could shed some light on policymakers move to raise rates.

source_identity.title: Yields & Oil
source_identity.body_text:
Outlook 10/08: Stock futures tick lower on Thursday as investors faced more pressure from rising Treasury yields and elevated oil prices. Yields and oil have stoked volatility in equities of late, as concern grows that higher energy prices will keep inflation elevated and force Federal Reserve to further raise rates. Many investors are maintaining an optimistic view of the stock market. They expect that the earnings season could give the market the fuel it needs for the next leg higher.
ESZ26 (Dec2026): YVAH 7859 YPOC 7853 YVAL 7827 GAP 7853 IVR 82
/ES Plan: Yesterday market closed balanced, but overnight looks 100% bearish (PBT 7787), moving below value, so these're the opening and initial balance options for current session:
A) If market moves above YVAL 7827 with bullish VIX/CVD, buy towards YPOC-GAP 7853 YVAH 7859 and GAP 7875 all magnets.
B) If market moves below YVAL 7827 with bearish VIX/CVD, sell towards PBT 7787 magnet and HVE 7768 (LOD exp).
Note: Overnight inventory is 100% bearish. The expected action is a counter-auction. Failure to see the counter-auction would be an indication of potential bearish trend day. If market opens below value and it begins to trade within value, VAR bullish setup comes in play.

source_identity.title: Yields & Oil
source_identity.body_text:
Outlook 10/08: Stock futures tick lower on Thursday as investors faced more pressure from rising Treasury yields and elevated oil prices. Yields and oil have stoked volatility in equities of late, as concern grows that higher energy prices will keep inflation elevated and force Federal Reserve to further raise rates. Many investors are maintaining an optimistic view of the stock market. They expect that the earnings season could give the market the fuel it needs for the next leg higher.
ESZ26 (Dec2026): YVAH 7859 YPOC 7853 YVAL 7827 GAP 7853 IVR 82
/ES Plan: Yesterday market closed balanced, but overnight looks 100% bearish (PBT 7787), moving below value, so these're the opening and initial balance options for current session:
A) If market moves above YVAL 7827 with bullish VIX/CVD, buy towards YPOC-GAP 7853 YVAH 7859 and GAP 7875 all magnets.
B) If market moves below YVAL 7827 with bearish VIX/CVD, sell towards PBT 7787 magnet and HVE 7768 (LOD exp).
Note: Overnight inventory is 100% bearish. The expected action is a counter-auction. Failure to see the counter-auction would be an indication of potential bearish trend day. If market opens below value and it begins to trade within value, VAR bullish setup comes in play.

source_identity.title: OpenAI worries
source_identity.body_text:
Outlook 10/09: Stock futures tick higher Friday, led by tech, following a losing session in which an underwhelming revenue report from OpenAI took some steam out of the high-flying artificial intelligence trade. AI stocks dropped on Thursday after OpenAI told investors that it saw $50 billion in annualized revenue at the end of September. Last month, a $68 billion figure was widely reported, though a person familiar with the matter said it also included gross revenue from partners.
ESZ26 (Dec2026): YVAH 7833 YPOC 7827 YVAL 7804 GAP 7822 IVR 84
/ES Plan: Yesterday market closed balanced, but overnight looks bullish (PBT 7877), moving above value, so these're the opening and initial balance options for current session:
A) If market remains above YVAH 7833 with bullish VIX/CVD, buy towards GAP-PBT 7875-77 magnets and ATH-RTH 7897.
B) If market moves below YVAH 7833 with bearish VIX/CVD, sell towards GAP 7822 magnet and YVAL-VAR 7804 magnet.
Note: Overnight inventory is 100% bullish. The expected action is a counter-auction. Failure to see the counter-auction would be an indication of potential bullish trend day to print a new record high. If market opens above value and it begins to trade within value, VAR bearish setup comes in play. It's 'Capital Preservation Friday'. Try to be calm and focus rather than thinking about your P/L Fridays are rebalanced days for funds managers based on market inflows.

Outlook 10/09: Stock futures tick higher Friday, led by tech, following a losing session in which an underwhelming revenue report from OpenAI took some steam out of the high-flying artificial intelligence trade. AI stocks dropped on Thursday after OpenAI told investors that it saw $50 billion in annualized revenue at the end of September. Last month, a $68 billion figure was widely reported, though a person familiar with the matter said it also included gross revenue from partners.
ESZ26 (Dec2026): YVAH 7833 YPOC 7827 YVAL 7804 GAP 7822 IVR 84
/ES Plan: Yesterday market closed balanced, but overnight looks bullish (PBT 7877), moving above value, so these're the opening and initial balance options for current session:
A) If market remains above YVAH 7833 with bullish VIX/CVD, buy towards GAP-PBT 7875-77 magnets and ATH-RTH 7897.
B) If market moves below YVAH 7833 with bearish VIX/CVD, sell towards GAP 7822 magnet and YVAL-VAR 7804 magnet.
Note: Overnight inventory is 100% bullish. The expected action is a counter-auction. Failure to see the counter-auction would be an indication of potential bullish trend day to print a new record high. If market opens above value and it begins to trade within value, VAR bearish setup comes in play. It's 'Capital Preservation Friday'. Try to be calm and focus rather than thinking about your P/L Fridays are rebalanced days for funds managers based on market inflows.

source_identity.title: Banks earnings
source_identity.body_text:
Outlook 10/13: Stock futures are mixed early Tuesday, with traders digesting a slew of corporate earnings reports from major banks along with a steep overnight decline in South Korea that put pressure on memory names. JPMorgan reported third-quarter earnings and revenue that missed expectations. The stock fell on the weaker-than-expected results, though it saw a slight boost at one point after the bank raised its net interest income guidance for 2026. Wells Fargo shed 2% on mixed Q3 numbers, while Goldman Sachs jumped 3% after its revenue for third quarter surpassed expectations. Investors on Tuesday will also parse through existing home sales figures along with commentary from Federal Reserve officials Tom Barkin and Susan Collins.
ESZ26 (Dec2026): YVAH 7864 YPOC 7856 YVAL 7849 GAP 7856 IVR 85

B) If market moves below HVE-YVAH 7850 with bearish VIX/CVD, sell towards ONL 7836 and PBT 7824 GAP 7822 both magnets.
Note: Market opens balanced. Don't be 'too anxious'. Stay patient. You don’t have to be the first. Bad trades occur when u try to force setups.

JPMorgan reported third-quarter earnings and revenue that missed expectations. The stock fell on the weaker-than-expected results, though it saw a slight boost at one point after the bank raised its net interest income guidance for 2026. Wells Fargo shed 2% on mixed Q3 numbers, while Goldman Sachs jumped 3% after its revenue for third quarter surpassed expectations. Investors on Tuesday will also parse through existing home sales figures along with commentary from Federal Reserve officials Tom Barkin and Susan Collins.
ESZ26 (Dec2026): YVAH 7864 YPOC 7856 YVAL 7849 GAP 7856 IVR 85
/ES Plan: Yesterday market closed bearish (PBT 7824), but overnight looks balanced, moving few ticks below value, so these're the opening and initial balance options for current session:
A) If market moves above HVE-YVAL 7850 with bullish VIX/CVD, buy towards GAP 7857 YVAH 7864 and PBT 7906 all magnets.
B) If market moves below HVE-YVAH 7850 with bearish VIX/CVD, sell towards ONL 7836 and PBT 7824 GAP 7822 both magnets.
Note: Market opens balanced. Don't be 'too anxious'. Stay patient. You don’t have to be the first. Bad trades occur when u try to force setups.

source_record.scenario_text: If market moves below YLOD 7835 with bearish VIX/CVD, sell towards ONL 7822 and HVE 7812.

source_identity.title: CPI data
source_identity.body_text:
Outlook 10/14: Stock futures fall into the red as hot inflation report sends yields higher. The consumer price index rose 0.6% in September month over month, with its year-over-year gain coming in at 3.7%. While the former was in line with expectations, the latter was hotter than expected, as economists anticipated a 3.6% advance on the year. Excluding food and energy prices, core CPI posted a monthly and yearly advance of 0.3% and 2.6%, respectively. Both were also slightly higher than the increase of 0.2% and 2.5% that economists had expected. Treasury yields jumped following the report, with the 10-year yield up more than 6 basis points at 5.278%.
ESZ26 (Dec2026): YVAH 7857 YPOC 7853 YVAL 7845 GAP 7857 IVR 87
/ES Plan: Yesterday market closed balanced, but overnight, after CPI, looks bearish, moving well below below value/range, so these're the opening and initial balance options for current session:
A) If market moves above YLOD 7835 with bullish VIX/CVD, buy GAP 7857 CPI-SOC 7878 magnets.
B) If market moves below YLOD 7835 with bearish VIX/CVD, sell towards ONL 7822 and HVE 7812.
Note: CPI reaction was 100% bearish. The expected action is a counter-auction. Failure to see the counter-auction to SoC level, would be an indication of potential bearish trend day. If market opens below value and it begins to trade within value, VAR bullish setup comes in play.

source_identity.title: CPI data
source_identity.body_text:
Outlook 10/14: Stock futures fall into the red as hot inflation report sends yields higher. The consumer price index rose 0.6% in September month over month, with its year-over-year gain coming in at 3.7%. While the former was in line with expectations, the latter was hotter than expected, as economists anticipated a 3.6% advance on the year. Excluding food and energy prices, core CPI posted a monthly and yearly advance of 0.3% and 2.6%, respectively. Both were also slightly higher than the increase of 0.2% and 2.5% that economists had expected. Treasury yields jumped following the report, with the 10-year yield up more than 6 basis points at 5.278%.
ESZ26 (Dec2026): YVAH 7857 YPOC 7853 YVAL 7845 GAP 7857 IVR 87
/ES Plan: Yesterday market closed balanced, but overnight, after CPI, looks bearish, moving well below below value/range, so these're the opening and initial balance options for current session:
A) If market moves above YLOD 7835 with bullish VIX/CVD, buy GAP 7857 CPI-SOC 7878 magnets.
B) If market moves below YLOD 7835 with bearish VIX/CVD, sell towards ONL 7822 and HVE 7812.
Note: CPI reaction was 100% bearish. The expected action is a counter-auction. Failure to see the counter-auction to SoC level, would be an indication of potential bearish trend day. If market opens below value and it begins to trade within value, VAR bullish setup comes in play.
